main_text.l: Synodis ad hoc usque tempus centum
plus minus anni , intra quod temporis
Provincijs mirum in modum auctus est;
quæ de Dionysio Demetrij post Heraclam
ita plures erant ante Dionysium in Ægy-
Dionysius non ad Ægyptum proprie per-
Provincias; nec à vero alienum putarim
ad id sollicitatæ fuerint celeberrimâ san-
ctissimi[?] Viri famâ, sive urbis Alexandriæ

page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred at the start of "sanctissimi" (the first letters are damaged) and the word is marked [?]. Otherwise the text is clear. The notes "Pearf." and "pag. 177." are placed beside the lines where they stand on the scan.
